extension.name: Pre-Spec Cards
extension.description: Card-based pre-spec thinking: paste an idea, get your card plus the paths you'd miss, then play each through — story, snags, trade-offs, difficulty vs payoff — before /speckit.specify.
extension.author: bendlikeabamboo

commands.name: speckit.prespec.idea
commands.description: Paste an idea — deduce the what/why and slug, confirm them with the user, keep your card, and deal the paths you might have missed

commands.name: speckit.prespec.playthrough
commands.description: Play each card through one by one — the story, the snags, the trade-offs, difficulty vs payoff — with a say-next rhythm
